development.curation: Agent-curated synthetic queries from checked-in seed content; not human-user or production-traffic labels.
development.chunkIdSemantics: Relevant IDs are the original documents[].chunks[].id values in the country JSON seeds. Runtime visa_chunks rows currently have generated UUIDs, so this set is a source-level gold set.
development.evidenceSemantics: Each evidence.text value is an exact substring of its source chunk's content and is limited to one or two sentences that support the query.
development.negativePolicy: An unanswerable case has no answer chunk under its exact filters, or its purpose is explicitly outside the filtered product. Negative rationale records the local-seed basis; no unsupported requirement is invented.
development.selectionPolicy: Tune on dev only. Use heldout once for final comparison. Positive source parents are partitioned between splits to avoid cross-split leakage.
development.runtimeFilterNote: Some items intentionally omit visaType while retaining country and documentTypes because runtime normalizes aliases such as DS160, UK_STANDARD_VISITOR, EU_SCHENGEN_C_SHORT_STAY, and ID_C1_TOURIST to values that differ from the seed product codes.

confirmation.curation: Agent-curated synthetic heldout confirmation queries from checked-in seed content; not human-user or production-traffic labels.
confirmation.chunkIdSemantics: Relevant IDs are the original documents[].chunks[].id values in the country JSON seeds. Runtime visa_chunks rows currently have generated UUIDs, so this set is a source-level gold set.
confirmation.evidenceSemantics: Every positive evidence.text value is copied verbatim from the referenced seed chunk content and is limited to one or two complete sentences. Multi-intent positives include each required source chunk.
confirmation.negativePolicy: An unanswerable case retains a non-empty candidate pool through its country/documentType filters, but the checked-in seeds do not contain the exact requested live, numeric, or unrelated information. Negative entries have empty relevantChunkIds and evidence.
confirmation.selectionPolicy: All 30 queries are heldout confirmation cases and must not be used for parameter selection. Every positive parent-country tuple is different from the positive tuples in rag-retrieval-queries.json. The cross-country template parents official_field_answer_norms and standard_passport_identity_field_rules are intentionally excluded.
confirmation.runtimeFilterNote: Visa types use source product codes or aliases known to normalizeVisaTypeFilter, including AU_VISITOR_600, EU_SCHENGEN_C_SHORT_STAY, EG_E_VISA, HK_VISIT_VISA, RU_E_VISA, and the corresponding native seed values. documentTypes are explicit so each negative retains a candidate pool.

provenance.note: After round-one rejection, all 72 old questions are development data. Only the newly authored disjoint confirmation set is heldout.

scope: Exact local cosine search over checked-in public country seeds; not the active DB, ANN index, live user traffic, or end-to-end answer quality.
baselineScope: Old vector parameters only; legacy unordered REST fallback is excluded and separately regression-tested.
selectionRule: dev recall >= baseline - 0; maximize 0.7 * positive macro F2 + 0.3 * negative abstention; ties: fewer context chars, then smaller k, then lower threshold. Heldout never reselects.
chunkingUnit: Unicode code points in seed content; production metadata retained per piece. Evidence spans must be fully covered by the union of retrieved source intervals; gaps do not count. Precision deduplicates parent sources, not overlap pieces.
precisionDefinition: Parent-source precision, not per-piece precision: a source is relevant if its retrieved intervals cover at least one complete gold span. Other retrieved pieces of the same source add context cost but no extra precision votes. retrieved[].relevant is source-level.
embeddingUsageScope: Cumulative real provider receipts for this local cache, including preparation. Batch latency is not per-query or end-to-end retrieval latency.

promotionGate.rule: heldout recall >= baseline - 0; F2 >= baseline; negative false-positive rate <= baseline

compatiblePromotionGate.rule: heldout recall >= baseline - 0; F2 >= baseline; negative false-positive rate <= baseline
